_comment: Benchmark cases: an EPANET network (inp/) and an MSX reaction file (msx/). reps repeats a short run inside one process so that it can be timed reliably. Sorted by size of network. Cases in group "output" report every node, link and species every 5 minutes; tools/bench.py runs them with --cases output. Cases in group "real" are larger real-world networks with three types of reactions each; tools/bench.py runs them with --cases real. Cases in group "stress" exercise paths the main cases do not: water age (segments that never merge) and full coupling; tools/bench.py runs them with --cases stress. Cases in group "literature" replicate published reaction models (DBP, two-reactant chlorine, temperature, inactivation, PODDS and VCDM discolouration) and add dispersion on a larger network; tools/bench.py runs them with --cases literature. Group "literature-large" runs the same published models on NW Model and BWSN2 (files written by tools/private-reactions.py); tools/bench.py runs them with --cases literature-large.
